phone.changelog: v3.4.0: Scan-to-pair — Remote tab now has a QR scanner: point your phone at the TV Settings QR and it connects instantly, no typing. Scanning the QR with the phone camera also opens the app straight into pairing. New unified design: Space Grotesk/Inter fonts and the teal AJO accent across the app, matching the TV.

tv.changelog: v3.12.73: Movies & series fixed — movibox CDN hotlink gate (429) handled: native player now sends Referer/UA headers; web/phone playback streams through the VPS proxy. Live channel thumbnails fixed — dead Sony logos repaired, logos served via image proxy with retry. Live channel playback untouched.

android_tv.changelog: v3.12.91: Pairing QR encodes the room code as an ajoapp:// deep link (matches the phone app intent filter) — scan with AJO Phone 3.4.0 and the phone connects and casts. No web page, no 404.
